question: Folk music sung on the birth of a child in some Indian states like Bihar, Uttar Pradesh, etc. is called _____.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sohar**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Folk music sung on the birth of a child in some Indian states like** Bihar, Uttar Pradesh**, and others is called **"Suhag" or "Suhag geet."**
 
• It is considered a way to celebrate the joy of childbirth and to bless the newborn.
 
• These songs are often** sung by female relatives**, including grandmothers, aunts, and sisters.
 
• The music may be accompanied by traditional instruments such as **dholak, morsing, or even hand claps.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
